summary_zh:
這裡是「斯卡夫塔山」旅客中心，旁邊的步道，車停在「Skaftafell Parking」，旁邊有旅客服務中心，要上廁所，用餐，只有這裡才有。

這瀑布，也叫作「玄武岩瀑布」，冰島非常少見的瀑布，走到這裡要花點時間，但我個人蠻推薦的。

從停車場沿著步道，花 20 分鐘上爬，會先經過「小狗瀑布」，經過他後，再往前走約 20-30 分鐘，就可以抵達，這段路前面有一點小坡，但不難走，走到瀑布下非常壯觀。
summary_en: This site is the Skaftafell Visitor Center on the southeast side of the park, with a trail nearby. Park at Skaftafell Parking, where there is a visitor service center, restrooms (free), and a restaurant. The waterfall, also called the basalt waterfall, is rare in Iceland and highly recommended. From the parking lot, follow the trail for about 20 minutes to reach the “Dog Waterfall,” then continue for another 20–30 minutes to the main waterfall. The route includes a slight uphill section but is not difficult. Allow roughly 90 minutes for the visit, including time to enjoy the view from the observation platform.
